title: The 100 trillion dollar banknote
caption:
In 2009, Zimbabwe printed a 100 trillion dollar note.
In late 2008, prices were doubling about every day.
Within months, the country stopped using its own currency.
comment: Could this happen to any currency? 👇
sources: Steve Hanke & Nicholas Krus, World Hyperinflations (Cato Institute, 2012)

scenes.say: In two thousand nine, Zimbabwe printed a one hundred trillion dollar banknote.
